name: Liefmans Fruitesse 0.0
food_pairings: Kettle Intense Truffle and Sea Salt
notes: Belgian alcohol-free fruit beer. Bright cherry red colour, red fruity intensity – cherries, raspberries, strawberries, blueberries, elderberries. Sparkling and light, best enjoyed on the rocks.
notes_de: Belgisches, alkoholfreies Fruchtbier. Leuchtend kirschrote Farbe, rote Fruchtintensität — Kirschen, Himbeeren, Erdbeeren, Heidelbeeren und Holunderbeeren. Prickelnd und leicht, am besten On the Rocks zu genießen.
